items: Added clickable '@' mentions to open user cards.
Added the user's color where applicable in chat panes.
Added keyboard hotkeys to quickly navigate through the client.
Minor touch ups to the appearance of chat notices.
Minor touch ups to the notification center.
Slight performance improvements to channel switching.
Enabled spellcheck in the chat composer.
Removed the initial mention from reply threads.
Fixed critical bug where joining a channel where you're banned starts a login loop.
Added a search feature with a better filtering system.
Added a viewable list of chatters in a channel.
Added the ability to autocomplete chatters using an '@' symbol.
Major redesign to the onboarding flow to be smoother.
Minor touchups to the settings panel and the about tab.
Minor change to the add channel and send message button styling.
Fixed an issue where the chat composer wouldn't reset after a timeout expired.
Fixed a few bugs regarding paused scrolling.
Added support for Automod actions and held messages.
Added support for real-time 7TV updates, like new emotes or emote set swaps.
Added detailed moderation actions when the user is a moderator.
Added a mod panel to manage chat modes like emote only or subscribers only.
Added an ephemeral notice above the chat composer to indicate current chat modes on connection.
Added visual support for cheermotes.
Added visual support for first-time chat messages.
Added channel updates for when a channel's stream title or category changes.
Chat panes are now virtualized to massively improve performance with multiple large channels.
Chat history now follows your deleted message appearance setting instead of being hidden.
Minor redesign to reply threads to actually appear as threads instead replying to one message.
Minor redesign to the sidebar to look better, since outlines looked bad at certain scales.
Minor redesign to the navbar to be more compact with the same functionality.
Minor redesign to the appearance of alerts like subs, announcements, and raids.
Minor redesign to the landing page to be more informative and readable.
Fixed a bug where long messages in the chat composer would overlap the latest messages in chat.
Fixed a bug where the chat composer placeholder wouldn't resize properly on window resize.
Fixed some minor issues with chatlist auto-scrolling.
Added better emote picker subcategories to support earned global emotes.
Fixed emotes being indiced incorrectly when using emojis.
Fixed the wrapping of tooltips especially near the edges of the window.
Changed the behavior of paused scrolling. The message list will be frozen until the user resumes scrolling.
The sidebar is now collapsible at any window size instead of only on smaller screens.
Improved tooltips to be more performant and much less buggy.
Adjusted the background of the top bar of chat panes to look better.
Improved user card UX by progressively loading more info as it comes in.
Added enabling notifications as an optional onboarding step.
Fixed notifications not working properly when installed as an app.
Fixed the notification center not always being scrollable.
Fixed timestamp setting not being respected in user cards.
Fixed notifications not being marked as read when the channel was focused.
Fixed navigating to this very changelog when an update released.
Lots of small performance improvements to the app.
The initial public release of Peepochat.
